now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 40, the Hellfire Club targets the singer Dazzler, and the X-Men step in.
cases: FX-003 The Dark Phoenix Crisis (X-Men: The Animated Series)

proposed.text: In episode 40, the Inner Circle Club targets the singer Dazzler, and the X-Men step in.

changes.evidence: The show never calls the group the Hellfire Club; on screen it is the Inner Circle Club. Wikipedia's episode 40 (The Dark Phoenix, Part I: Dazzled) summary: 'When the Inner Circle Club learn of the Phoenix's power... While protecting Dazzler, a mutant club singer from being abducted by the Inner Circle, Cyclops and the X-Men get caught in this dangerous affair.' Marvel Database names the group 'Inner Circle Club (Earth-92131)' and says Dazzler was kidnapped by the Circle Club's Donald Pierce.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 10, Magneto plunges Earth into a blackout from Asteroid M, then vanishes in time when the asteroid explodes.

proposed.text: In episode 10, having plunged Earth into a blackout, Magneto makes his stand on Asteroid M, then vanishes in time when the asteroid explodes.

changes.evidence: Magneto does not cause the blackout from Asteroid M. In episode 8, once Cooper frees him, he creates the worldwide blackout (Marvel Database: he 'traveled to the North Pole and used the planet's magnetic field to unleash a global EMP'). Only in episode 9 does he re-establish Asteroid M, 'choosing to leave Earth without power'. Episode 10: the asteroid is sent into space, where it explodes, and the X-Men are scattered through time.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 5, Genosha's mutant council asks Magneto and Rogue to lead it, and the island joins the UN.

proposed.text: In episode 5, Genosha's mutant council asks Magneto to lead it, and he agrees if Rogue leads with him, as the island joins the UN.

changes.evidence: The council asks Magneto only, and Rogue's role is his own condition. Wikipedia episode 5 (Remember It): 'the Genoshan council asks Magneto to lead the country; he agrees on the condition that Rogue leads with him.' Marvel Database: 'Genosha's new ruling council offered Magneto the role of chancellor... Magneto accepted, on the condition that Rogue would also be given a role on the council.'
